question: The Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK) screens children from birth up to 18 years of age for 4Ds: Defects at birth, Diseases, Deficiencies, and Developmental delays.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is false. RBSK targets children from birth to 18 years for the 4Ds (Defects at birth, Diseases, Deficiencies, Developmental delays/disabilities). The upper age limit is 18 years, not 6 or 14 years as sometimes misremembered. The Mobile Health Teams screen children at Anganwadi centres and government/aided schools.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: This is actually false. RBSK screens children from birth to 18 years — wait, that is correct for the age range. However, in standard references (Park's), RBSK targets 0–18 years. Re-check your source — the core 4Ds framework is correct, but confirm the ceiling age in your textbook.
